description: This Java class implements the WELL19937c pseudo-random number generator, extending the AbstractWell class. It provides constructors for different seed options and overrides the next method to generate random bits using the WELL19937c algorithm, based on papers by François Panneton, Pierre L'Ecuyer, and Makoto Matsumoto.

classes.name: Well19937c
classes.description: Implements the WELL19937c pseudo-random number generator, a modification of the WELL family of generators, providing multiple constructors for seed flexibility.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Generates the next random number with a specified number of bits, implementing the core algorithm of WELL19937c and including Matsumoto-Kurita tempering for maximum equidistribution.
